units.source_text: “当时我想：‘这个人如此顺从我，战战兢兢地防止失却我的欢心。

en.t: At the time I thought, 'This woman obeys me so completely and trembles with fear lest she lose my favor.

units.source_text: 我如果对她惩戒一番，恐吓一下，她的嫉妒之癖也许会改去，不再噜苏了。’

en.t: If I punished her a little and frightened her, perhaps her habit of jealousy would be corrected, and she would stop making such a fuss.'

units.source_text: 实际上我的确忍无可忍了。

en.t: In truth, I really had reached the limit of my patience.

units.source_text: 于是又想：‘我若向她提出：从此断绝交往，

en.t: Then I thought again, 'If I tell her that from now on we must break off all relations,

units.source_text: 如果她真心向往于我，一定可以惩戒她的恶癖吧。’

en.t: then, if she truly longs for me, surely I can discipline her out of this bad habit.'

units.source_text: 我就装出冷酷无情的样子来。

en.t: So I put on an air of cold-hearted cruelty.

units.source_text: 她照例生气，怨恨满腹。

en.t: As usual, she became angry and filled herself with resentment.

units.source_text: 我对她说：‘你如此固执，即使宿缘何等深厚，

en.t: I said to her, 'If you are this stubborn, then no matter how deep our bond from former lives may be,

units.source_text: 也只得从此绝交，永不再见。

en.t: we can only end things here and never see each other again.

units.source_text: 如果你情愿今朝和我诀别，尽请吃你的无名之醋吧。

en.t: If you are willing to part from me this very morning, then go ahead and indulge your groundless jealousy as much as you like.

units.source_text: 但倘要做久长夫妻，那么即使我有不是之处，

en.t: But if you want us to remain husband and wife for a long time, then even if I am at fault,

units.source_text: 你也该忍耐，不可认真。

en.t: you should endure it and not take it so seriously.

units.source_text: 只要你改去了你的嫉妒之心，我便真心爱你。

en.t: As long as you rid yourself of your jealous heart, I will truly love you.

units.source_text: 今后我也会升官晋爵，飞黄腾达。

en.t: In the future I too will rise in office, gain rank, and make a splendid career.

units.source_text: 那时你作了第一夫人，也不同凡俗了。’

en.t: When that time comes, you will be my chief lady, and your position will be far above the ordinary.'

units.source_text: 我自以为这番话说得高明，便得意忘形，信口开河。

en.t: Thinking I had spoken very cleverly, I lost myself in pride and began talking recklessly.

units.source_text: 岂知这女子微微一笑，回答道：‘你现在一事无成，

en.t: But this woman merely smiled faintly and replied, 'At present you have accomplished nothing,

units.source_text: 身微名贱，要我耐心等待你的发迹，我毫无痛苦。

en.t: your rank is low and your name obscure; if you ask me to wait patiently for your success, that causes me no pain at all.

units.source_text: 但倘要我忍受你的薄倖，静候你的改悔，

en.t: But if you ask me to endure your faithlessness and quietly wait for you to repent,

units.source_text: 则日月悠长，希望渺茫，却是我所最感痛苦的！

en.t: then the days and months would be long, hope would be faint, and that is what would hurt me most of all!

units.source_text: 那么现在就是诀别的时候了。’

en.t: In that case, now is the time for us to part.'

units.source_text: 她的语气异常强硬。

en.t: Her tone was unusually firm.

units.source_text: 我也愤怒起来，厉声说了许多痛恨的话。

en.t: I too grew angry and said many bitter, hateful things in a harsh voice.

units.source_text: 这女子并不让步，拉过我的手去，猛力一咬，

en.t: The woman would not give way; she pulled my hand toward her and bit it fiercely,

units.source_text: 竟咬伤了我一根手指。

en.t: actually wounding one of my fingers with her bite.

units.source_text: 我大声叫痛，威吓她道：‘我的身体受了摧残，

en.t: I cried out loudly in pain and threatened her, saying, 'My body has been maimed;

units.source_text: 从此不能参与交际，我的前程被你断送了。

en.t: from now on I cannot take part in society, and you have ruined my future.

units.source_text: 我还有何面目见人？只有入山削发为僧了！

en.t: How can I still show my face before others? I have no choice but to enter the mountains, shave my head, and become a monk!

units.source_text: 那么今天就和你永别吧。’

en.t: Then today I shall part from you forever.'

units.source_text: 我屈着受伤的手指走出门去，临行吟道：

en.t: Bending my injured finger, I walked out the door, and as I left I recited:
